race.comment: TALK ABOUT LAYLA (8) made a complete mess of her rivals when shedding the maiden tag at the Gold Coast, then narrowly missed from making it two on the bounce here last time. At her  top now and if Moor can have her midfield or better from the middle draw she will take plenty of stitching. LADY TANGALOOMA (6) continues to leave herself with too much to do but has a strong turn of foot on her day, as seen last start when ripping home at Ipswich to just miss the bob. Will be hoping for a strong tempo. PINK DOGWOOD (7) stretched out nicely in tough conditions to get off the mark here two weeks ago. Has more to offer and should eat up the extra 200m. Have to consider. SHOW'EM WHO'S KING (1) wasn't beaten far in fourth when resuming at the Gold Coast. His best trip looks to be over further, so he should appreciate the mile second-up.
